blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The modernization of Rizal Memorial Baseball Stadium is getting closer to completion ahead of the country’s hosting of the East Asia Baseball Championships. Recent photos posted by the Philippine Sports Commission showed the installation of an artificial turf that will replace the natural grass that has been in place since the stadium was constructed almost a century ago. New seats are also being placed in the grandstand as workers are looking to meet the target finish of Nov. 30 set by PSC chairman Patrick Gregorio.
